Expected spans per document, in order, after normalization (whitespace runs -> one space, stripped; a markdown separator row's dash runs -> '---'). Rules: a heading joins the span that follows it; a table's header row + separator row is one span, then one span per data row; a list item is one span; prose splits into sentences, never after a common abbreviation (e.g., i.e., vs., approx., No., dia., Req.) or at a decimal.
textile_spec_sheet.md: Fabric Specification Sheet Spec No.: FS-2041-B
Construction Fabric structure: single jersey, 1x1 lycra plated.
The fabric is knitted on a 30" dia. machine at 28 gauge; the stitch length is approx. 2.85 mm.
Lycra is fed on every feeder (i.e. full plating), not alternate feeders.
Yarn supplier: e.g. Vardhman or equivalent
Finishing route Heat-setting at 190 °C, speed 18 m/min.
Drying, then compacting to finished width.
Remarks: Req. finished GSM 180 ± 5; finished width 68".
textile_test_report.md: Test Report TR-0398 Sample: knitted T-shirt, style 107-208, colour navy.
Summary The sample meets the dimensional stability requirement.
It does not meet the colour fastness to laundering requirement (grade 3 vs. required 4).
Bursting strength was 412 kPa, i.e. above the 350 kPa minimum.
Results | Test | Method | Result | Requirement | Pass/Fail | |---|---|---|---|---|
| Dimensional stability | AATCC 135 | -3.1% length | max. -5% | Pass |
| Colour fastness to laundering | ISO 105-C06:2010 | Grade 3 | Grade 4 | Fail |
| Bursting strength | ASTM D3786 | 412 kPa | 350 kPa min. | Pass |
Recommendations Re-dye with a reactive dye recipe and re-test to ISO 105-C06.
